Maps & Data
Use our basic web map, below, or browse our collection of pre-built map applications . Are you a GIS professional? Visit the open data downloads section for access to official county data sets.
Additional Applications
(opens in new tab)
Find parcels and their associated records. Instantly view key property information, such as tax assessments, sales history, and permits, or submit a request for a new address. The map contains links to DNR lakes, township information, and several years of aerial photography.
(opens in new tab)
Apply for an E911 address, or get your existing address sign replaced.
(To update your tax statement mailing address, visit Change Your Mailing Address .)
(opens in new tab)
Create downloadable mailing lists and labels. Lists can be created from selecting lakes, parcels, fire departments, ambulance zones or a custom list.

Disclaimer
The information on this page is made available as a public service. Maps and data are to be used for reference purposes only, and the information on cadastral maps is used to locate, identify and inventory parcels of land in Otter Tail County is for REFERENCE ONLY and is NOT TO BE CONSTRUED OR USED AS A LEGAL DESCRIPTION.
Map information is believed to be accurate but accuracy is not guaranteed.
In no event will Otter Tail County be liable for any damages, including loss of data, lost profits, business interruption, loss of business information or other pecuniary loss that may arise from the use of these maps and/or the information they contain.
